formats.op-eds: A letter to the editor or short op-ed pitch for the outlet named in the source. Hook in the first sentence, one argument, one concrete example. Letters: at most 200 words (the official cap). Write in the source's language (Spanish for La Nación / La Gaceta, English for the LA Times).
formats.trends: A post for LinkedIn or X on a discussion that is already running. 600 to 1200 characters, one claim, one piece of evidence or mechanism, no hashtags unless natural, no emojis. In English unless the source is Spanish.
formats.commentary: A forum or comment-thread reply. 80 to 200 words. Add something the thread lacks (a mechanism, a reference, a counterexample); answer the actual question; no self-promotion; match the thread's register. Same language as the source.
